comparisons.peer_topic: Revenue recognition for non-recurring engineering (NRE) contracts
comparisons.peer_summary: NRE contract revenue is generally recognized over time based on the input method of costs incurred, as customers consume services during development. Revenue for NRE contracts not meeting over-time criteria is recognized at a point in time when services are complete.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Broadcom disclose that a portion of their revenue is recognized over time, specifically for custom development and non-recurring engineering (NRE) activities. AMD reports that custom products and development services accounted for approximately 8% of its total revenue in 2024. Broadcom states that the majority of its NRE contracts (which include custom chip development) meet the over-time recognition criteria and are recognized over the development period using the input method based on costs incurred.

sentences.text: Revenue recognized over time associated with custom products and development services accounted for approximately 8%, 25% and 24% of the Company's revenue in 2024, 2023 and 2022, respectively.

There are two main categories of NRE contracts that we enter into with our customers: (a) NRE contracts in which we develop a custom chip and (b) NRE contracts in which we accelerate our development of a new chip upon the customer's request.
The majority of our NRE contract revenues meet the over time criteria.
As such, revenue is recognized over the development period with the measure of progress using the input method based on costs incurred to total cost as the services are provided.

peer_results.rationale: Intelligent disclosed that substantially all revenue is recognized at a point in time upon shipment or delivery, contrasting with AMD's specific disclosure of revenue recognized over time for custom products and development services.

Micron's candidate disclosures concern customer concentration risk and ESPP accounting, which do not share the same specific topic of revenue recognition timing for custom development services as the target.
